author: SKIZZOO
install_msg: Load with [p]load red_sentinel. Configure the web API with [p]sentinel token.
name: Red Sentinel
short: Visual web admin panel, audit log, moderation and social announcement routing for Red-DiscordBot.
description: A full web control plane for Red-DiscordBot with event logging, moderation actions, announcements, routing and social webhook ingestion.
end_user_data_statement: Red Sentinel stores Discord event audit records and configuration locally on the Red host. Server administrators can delete the local SQLite database to remove stored event records.
